channel.description: Public listing at the original URL; first page of updates, not the full archive. Exact publication day omitted where unavailable.

item.title: Rethinking European equities: They aren’t just for diversification anymore
item.description: The longer-term case for European equities includes valuation, diversification, a genuine fiscal turn, a sector mix suited to today's regime, and income generation.

item.title: Implementation of reforms takes centre stage for pensions
item.description: Pensions policy is moving from design to delivery across the UK, the Netherlands, and Germany — and implementation risk now matters as much as policy direction.

item.title: Insurers: Private markets can offer diversification in a mixed investment environment
item.description: Insurers need to diversify return sources, reduce exposure to correlated shocks, and optimise capital efficiency. Selective allocations to private markets can help.

item.title: Why insurers are taking a fresh look at structured credit
item.description: AAA CLOs may help insurers seek floating-rate income, diversification, and capital efficiency while managing liquidity and governance risks.

item.title: Navigating private markets for insurers
item.description: The Invesco Solutions team shares their views on a range of private market asset classes and investment implications for insurers.

item.title: Emerging markets: The forces shaping a potential multi year trend
item.description: After a strong 2025, can emerging market stocks continue to outperform developed markets in the coming years? We believe they can, thanks to several structural reasons and cyclical factors.

item.title: Active Fixed Income ETFs: Bond expertise meets ETF efficiency
item.description: Integrating fundamental active management into an ETF wrapper isn’t always straightforward. Discover how intelligent product structure and strategy design can overcome the challenges in fixed income for a unique new tool for investors.

item.title: Build efficient bond ladders with Invesco BulletShares ETFs
item.description: Bond ladders, portfolios of bonds with staggered maturity dates, can enhance diversification, provide cash flow flexibility, and help reduce exposure to interest rate volatility. Learn how to use Invesco BulletShares ETFs in a bond ladder.

item.title: Global Fixed Income Strategy Monthly Report | October 2026
item.description: Discover our Global Fixed Income Strategy Monthly Report, we offer an outlook for interest rates and currencies and look at which fixed income assets are favoured across a range of market environments.

item.title: Capital market assumptions | Q3 2026
item.description: Invesco Solutions develops capital market assumptions (CMAs) that provide long-term estimates for the behaviour of major asset classes globally.

item.title: 2026 midyear outlook: A world disrupted? Resilience endures.
item.description: In a time of immense disruption, we believe resilience endures and provides a favourable investment environment for the rest of the year.

item.title: Solvency II: 2027 Securitisation Reform for EU Insurers
item.description: Solvency II is changing from January 2027. See how the securitisation recalibration affects capital charges across CLOs, ABS and RMBS for European insurers.

item.title: Turning access into action
item.description: How behavioural insights can help Europe’s savers become investors

item.title: Systematic active ETFs: Redefining core equity exposure
item.description: We examine how factor-based strategies combine proven alpha sources with disciplined risk control to target benchmark-relative outperformance.

item.title: Equal weight ETFs: reducing market concentration
item.description: Explore how equal weight ETFs can reduce reliance on the largest companies in an index, from the S&P 500 to global and European equities.

item.title: Tactical asset allocation
item.description: Welcome to our Tactical Asset Allocation hub. Here you’ll find a selection of the most recent research from Invesco Solutions. Read our latest analysis that covers market strategy and opportunities across various asset classes.

item.title: Where you’ll find the cheapest and most expensive stock markets in the world
item.description: Find out what regional stock markets look cheap or expensive and learn from our experts about investing opportunities and risks around the world.

item.title: Inside the markets | Helping you guide clients
item.description: September proved challenging for investors as rising bond yields, inflation concerns and higher-for-longer interest rates weighed on markets, reinforcing the importance of maintaining a diversified portfolio.

item.title: Rising yields won't break the economy or stocks
item.description: Our Strategy & Insights team explore why rising bond yields may reflect stronger growth, what higher rates could mean for markets, and the possible implications for bonds and equities.

item.title: Quarterly Gold Insights: A review of gold in Q3 2026 and outlook for the rest of the year
item.description: Explore the latest gold price trends, inflation and Fed rate expectations, plus our outlook for gold and how an allocation might help with portfolio diversification.
